title: BVAL brand deal check
description: Paste a creator handle and the brand's offer. BVAL scrapes recent performance, prices every term of the deal from cited 2026 benchmarks, gives a verdict, and drafts the counter-offer email.

platform.title: Platform
platform.description: Where the sponsored content will be posted. Each platform is priced on its own anchor metric: Instagram Reel plays, TikTok plays, YouTube views on videos 30+ days old.

handle.title: Creator handle or profile URL
handle.description: For example @creator or https://www.instagram.com/creator/. The account must be public.

creatorName.title: Creator name (for the email sign-off)
creatorName.description: Optional. Defaults to the profile's display name.

niche.title: Niche
niche.description: Sets the niche multiplier (finance 1.9x ... gaming 0.55x vs lifestyle 1.0x).

deliverables.title: Deliverables
deliverables.description: List of {"type", "qty"}. Instagram: instagram_reel, instagram_story_frame, instagram_static_post, instagram_carousel. TikTok: tiktok_video. YouTube: youtube_integration, youtube_mention_15_30s, youtube_dedicated, youtube_short. Leave empty for one main deliverable of the chosen platform.

offerAmount.title: Brand's offer (amount)
offerAmount.description: What the brand offered for the whole deal. Leave empty to get a quote only.

offerCurrency.title: Offer currency
offerCurrency.description: Currency of the brand's offer. Converted at the market's configured exchange rate.

giftedOnly.title: Product only (gifted, no fee)
giftedOnly.description: Tick if the brand offers only free product.

organicUsageDays.title: Organic usage rights (days)
organicUsageDays.description: How long the brand may repost the content on its own channels, website or email. 0 = none.

paidUsageDays.title: Paid usage rights (days)
paidUsageDays.description: How long the brand may run the content in its own paid ads. 0 = none.

whitelistingDays.title: Whitelisting days (Partnership Ads / Spark Ads)
whitelistingDays.description: Ads run through the creator's handle: Meta Partnership Ads on Instagram, Spark Ads on TikTok. Not offered on YouTube (priced as paid usage). 0 = none.

adSpendUsd.title: Planned ad spend behind whitelisting (USD)
adSpendUsd.description: Optional. If given, the whitelisting fee is at least 3% of ad spend.

perpetualRights.title: Perpetual rights requested
perpetualRights.description: Tick if the contract asks for usage in perpetuity.

exclusivityDays.title: Exclusivity (days)
exclusivityDays.description: How long the creator may not work with competitors. Up to 7 days around the post is normally free.

exclusivityScope.title: Exclusivity scope
exclusivityScope.description: Category = no direct competitors; full = no other brands at all (priced at 2x).

rushHours.title: Delivery deadline (hours, 0 = standard)
rushHours.description: Under 72h adds a rush fee (+35%; under 24h +50%).

revisionRounds.title: Revision rounds requested
revisionRounds.description: One round is included; each extra round is priced.

rawFootage.title: Raw footage requested
rawFootage.description: Unedited files delivered to the brand (+25%).

crossPostPlatforms.title: Cross-post to other platforms
crossPostPlatforms.description: Number of extra platforms the same content is posted to (+25% each).

pinnedCommentLink.title: Pinned-comment link
pinnedCommentLink.description: YouTube only. A description link is included in every integration.

paymentTermsDays.title: Payment terms (Net days)
paymentTermsDays.description: Days after delivery the brand pays. Over 60 is flagged.

depositPct.title: Deposit (%)
depositPct.description: Upfront payment the brand offers. Under 50% is flagged.

aiTrainingClause.title: AI training or likeness clause
aiTrainingClause.description: Tick if the contract lets the brand use the content or likeness to train AI.

market.title: Audience market (country)
market.description: Where most of the creator's audience lives, as an ISO country code (US, IN, GB, BR, DE, ID, MX, CA, ...), or GLOBAL for US benchmarks. Brands pay by audience location, so this changes the price; any country works, falling back to its regional group.

outputCurrency.title: Show prices in
outputCurrency.description: USD, or LOCAL for the market's own currency.

generateEmail.title: Draft the counter-offer email
generateEmail.description: Writes a ready-to-send reply using only the computed numbers.

llmModel.title: LLM model (optional)
llmModel.description: OpenRouter model slug for the email, called through Apify's OpenRouter proxy. Leave empty for the default.

manualMetrics.title: Manual metrics (skip scraping)
manualMetrics.description: Optional. {"followers": 85000, "medianViews": 42000, "engagementRate": 0.035}. For YouTube you may add "medianShortsViews". Use this to re-price new terms without scraping again.
